name: sakura
source:
A visual novel about a girl who dreams of overcoming her social anxiety and creating her own music club, assisted by her friends.

[translated from [url=https://s1lf1n.itch.io/sakura-visual-novel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一部视觉小说，讲述了一个女孩梦想克服社交焦虑并在朋友的帮助下创建自己的音乐俱乐部的故事。
